title: Top 500 Technology / Software Engineering Companies
scope: Companies relevant to software engineering, product engineering, cloud, AI/ML, cybersecurity, fintech, SaaS, IT services and technology-enabled engineering roles, with strong India relevance.

grade_definition.S: Highest priority — exceptional engineering brand/product depth and/or strong compensation and career upside.
grade_definition.A: High priority — strong product/engineering organization and good target for experienced software engineers.
grade_definition.B: Good target — substantial engineering hiring, services/consulting, specialized technology, or strong domain relevance.

important_note: Career URLs are intended as a curated starting dataset. Career portals and ATS routes change; validate the URL before automated browsing/application. Do not auto-submit applications without human review.
source_context: The 2026 ranking was curated using current India tech-employer/career-page references, including sources showing major tech employers and a current dataset tracking 617 India tech companies across company career pages and ATS platforms.
